review_reference: Owner decisions in chat on 2026-11-11: Option B, drafts only for staff given the dedicated records-processing permission for that patient, never through shares or PINs, a draft stays a draft until a clinician signs it; and "Should a patient’s write share let another facility publish paper-record (Migrate) readings into that patient’s record? YES". First numbered 0112, renumbered 0113 by the coordinator on 2026-11-11 (0111 campaign admins, 0112 7-day deletion release first). SIGNED by the owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-11-11 (~11:20 UTC): "Q40: 0113 signed".
evidence: Single migration 0113_records_processing_draft_publication.sql plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHAT IT DOES: a staff member holding the patient's dedicated records-processing grant (an approved healthcare-operations write_records request of at most 24 hours, approved by the patient; never a share, an Access PIN or an approval of direct care) may publish an OCR reading of a paper record as a DRAFT note into one "Imported paper records" encounter per patient per facility; a clinician signs it later under direct care. New objects: identity.records_processing_write_grant (SECURITY DEFINER check), ehr.encounters.imported_paper_records (with a partial unique index and a trigger that keeps the flag fixed), ehr.imported_paper_records_encounter (SECURITY INVOKER), ehr.imported_paper_records_signed (the patient sees the encounter only once it holds a signed note), ehr.records_processing_draft_guard (under healthcare-operations the database allows only that encounter, an unsigned revision-1 paper-record draft in it and its first revision), and ocr.publications.publication_basis with a trigger that keeps it fixed, so every retry takes the route the request was authorized on. Structured Lab and Pharmacy records still need direct care. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: new columns default to false / NULL (NULL read as direct care); today's services never set them; the patient-self encounter policy is unchanged for ordinary encounters. RELEASE ORDER: after 0111 (#222) and 0112 (#226). PROVED (Session B, 2026-11-11, throwaway PostgreSQL 16 only): fresh install 0001-0113 (0111 absent) with all 85 database suites passing, records-processing-draft 91 cases, OCR publication suite 31 cases; ehr-api 839, ocr-api 373 tests; four independent reviews, last with nothing Critical, High or Medium. Owner decisions of 2026-11-11 (Option B; write shares may publish paper-record readings) are recorded in the migration header and PR #229; the owner signs this declaration.
